claims.fact: The phenomenological description contains the SM Higgs and one real massive vector X_mu, odd under X_mu -> -X_mu. Eq. (18) is explicitly agnostic to mass origin. Its algebra in this effective description is g_SM; X is independent singlet Lorentz-vector matter, not an added massless U(1) connection.
